metadata.title: Email Records Management Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines the architectural pattern for records management, retention, legal hold, and discovery for institutional email services. This pattern is vendor-agnostic and expresses governance and compliance intent, not product implementation.

components.title: Email Records Management and Discovery
components.description: Ensures that institutional email content and metadata are retained, preserved, discoverable, and disposed of according to legal, regulatory, and institutional records management obligations.

links.text: Technology Reference Model - Records and Information Management

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email systems must generate and retain audit records sufficient to support accountability, investigations, and compliance.
Audit records and email artifacts must be protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.
Email records must support recovery and preservation in accordance with retention and continuity requirements.
Institutional records obligations require retention, legal hold, and discovery support for email communications.
Records handling must respect proportionality and avoid unnecessary or excessive retention of personal communications.

components.remarks: This pattern defines architectural requirements for email records governance, including retention schedules, legal hold, eDiscovery, and defensible disposal. Product-specific archiving technologies, retention configurations, and lifecycle details are defined in realization artifacts.
